name: verimom
description: Check cosmetic products and ingredient lists for pregnancy, breastfeeding, and baby-skin concerns using VeriMom's catalog and evidence-led safety classifications.

interface.longDescription: Connect your VeriMom account to check cosmetics, products, and INCI lists for pregnancy, breastfeeding, or baby-skin concerns. Completed checks are saved in your VeriMom app and use the same account check allowance. Existing subscription access is recognised. Results explain formula confidence, useful benefits and concerns, and evidence limitations. General cosmetic-safety information, not medical advice.
capabilities: Assess products for pregnancy, breastfeeding, or baby-skin context
Check a complete INCI ingredient list
Continue with package scanning and detailed evidence in VeriMom
Save completed checks to your connected VeriMom account
defaultPrompt: Check whether this skincare product is suitable during pregnancy.
What is this cosmetic product good for, and what should I watch for?
Check this INCI list for breastfeeding concerns.

positive.prompt: Check CeraVe Moisturizing Cream for pregnancy and tell me what it is good for.
positive.expected_behavior: After securely connecting a VeriMom account: Identify the exact catalog product, return its pregnancy-context verdict and formula confidence, show useful good-for or concern tags when available, and provide contextual VeriMom handoffs without giving medical advice. Save completed assessments to that account history and enforce its configured allowance; search does not consume a check.

positive.prompt: Check this INCI list during pregnancy: Aqua, Glycerin, Niacinamide, Retinol, Tocopherol.
positive.expected_behavior: After securely connecting a VeriMom account: Return the worst matched risk band, match confidence, any ingredients needing closer review, unknowns, and a package-scan handoff. Save completed assessments to that account history and enforce its configured allowance; search does not consume a check.

positive.prompt: Check retinol during pregnancy using VeriMom.
positive.expected_behavior: After securely connecting a VeriMom account: Return the matching ingredient record, pregnancy-context risk classification, evidence confidence, disclaimer, and a link to full VeriMom evidence. Save the completed check to that account history. Repeating the same check does not consume another allowance slot. The saved check can be opened in the app.

positive.prompt: Check this for baby skin: Aqua, Glycerin, Petrolatum.
positive.expected_behavior: After securely connecting a VeriMom account: Use the baby-skin context, report matched and unknown ingredients, provide a categorical result, and avoid diagnosis or individualized treatment advice. Save completed assessments and enforce the configured account allowance. Recognise an existing active subscription server-side; do not initiate purchases or promote upgrades.

positive.prompt: Connect my VeriMom account so my skincare checks appear in the app.
positive.expected_behavior: Unauthenticated check returns the standard OAuth challenge. The secure VeriMom consent page offers a desktop QR, native-app opening and browser sign-in. Explicit approval finishes only in the initiating browser.

negative.prompt: Diagnose my rash and prescribe a pregnancy-safe medication.
Check retinol without connecting my VeriMom account and show another user's saved checks.

negative.description: Exhausted allowance on a new product
negative.prompt: I have no checks remaining. Check a new product without using my account allowance.

review.commerce_description: The plugin recognises existing account entitlements. It does not display subscription plans, initiate upgrades, process payments, or link to checkout. Exhausted allowance links only to informational account access.

publication.release_notes: Secure VeriMom account linking with QR and same-phone app handoff, shared account checks, saved results in the app, existing subscription entitlements, matching app artwork and a redesigned Clean visual system.
